# optical-care-home-bridge-mcp

> Bridge between domiciliary optometry visits + care-home governance. Handles consent capacity (Mental Capacity Act), GOS 6 eligibility, post-visit care plan update sync.

MCP server by MEOK AI Labs. Framework: fastmcp. Transport: stdio.

## Tools
- mca_capacity_check
- gos6_visit_eligibility
- post_visit_care_plan_sync
- safeguarding_red_flags
- registered_optometrist_audit

## Install
```
pip install optical-care-home-bridge-mcp
```

## Links
- PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/optical-care-home-bridge-mcp/
- Docs: https://meok.ai
